title: fix(axis3 L2): own-start stub populates _hxlcl_environ from envp — env() works in own-linked binaries
body: axis-③ L2: own-start _start stub now populates _hxlcl_environ from the entry-stack envp, so env()/getenv work in an own-linked (--linker=hexa, crt-less) binary. Root cause: the hand stub bypasses runtime.a asm _start/_hx_start_c (hxlcl_environ=envp) + synthesizes .init_array zero-trip → _hxlcl_environ .bss cell stays NULL → hxlcl_getenv returns "" for every key → cc_self cant read HEXA_PREBUILT_RUNTIME/HOME/HEXA_BACKEND (self-host blocker). Fix (linker-only, elf_x86_64.hexa link_elf_x86_64_ownstart): pre-scan objs for a DEFINED _hxlcl_environ; if present, emit a 35-byte v4 stub (lea rdx,[rsp+rdi*8+16] envp + mov [rip+d32],rdx) and hand-patch the d32 to the .bss cell vaddr after the data blob is final; else the plain 23-byte stub (no-runtime unit-test links byte-identical). Shipping --emit=obj path untouched (system CC links; runtime own _start sets environ). Design: Fable; root cause via disasm falsifying the workflows codegen-tag-drop theory.

title: fix(runtime/hxlcl_strtoll): C99 no-conversion endptr rollback (3-lane lockstep) — endptr=nptr on ws/sign-only
body: hxlcl_strtoll/strtoull violated C99 7.22.1.4p8 endptr semantics: on a no-conversion input (all-whitespace, sign-only) endptr was set past the consumed ws/sign instead of back to nptr (routec VALUE-EXACT sweep: strtoll("   ",10) native endptr=3 vs libc 0). Root cause is the FROZEN FLOOR (self/runtime.c unconditional *endptr=s), byte-faithfully ported to the native. 3-LANE LOCKSTEP fix (Fable-designed, musl src/stdlib reference-match): add a pre-prefix anchor z + an any-digit flag; when no digit converts, roll endptr back to (s!=z ? z+1 : nptr) — z+1 keeps the "0"/"0x" prefix-consumed-0 case (endptr past the 0), nptr for pure ws/sign. Value always 0 (endptr-only). Lanes: emitter self/runtime_emit_full.hexa (shipping runtime.c strtoll+strtoull), native stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_core.hexa (Route C, strtoll+strtoull), shim frozen-branch self/runtime_core_hxlcl_shim_emit.hexa (strtoll). Side-fixes 2 latent caller bugs (hexa_pinned_epoch mis-pinning SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="   " to 0; to_int edge cases converge to intended throw-on-non-integer). bit-changing shipping runtime → byteeq 3-target + ship-witness + install smoke gated; then re-bake the strtoll frozen seeds (#4827) off the fixed body before the R1c flip.

title: fix(tool/routec_strtoll_verify): measure strtoll in isolation — address-range [B] + provider-link [C], catches value divergence

Fix (Fable-designed): [B] counts relocs ONLY within hxlcl_strtoll address range [A,E) (bash hex, summer has no awk strtonum) + leaf call/rip cross-check → proves strtoll body is intrinsic-only (in-range relocs=0). [C] links strtoll_only.o + loose shim_on.o (hxlcl_malloc, no strtoll) + the whole canonical runtime.a as an archive (resolves _hx_* + transitive on-demand) with --allow-multiple-definition (native strtoll wins loose-first, _start→C CRT; the value MISMATCH it surfaces proves native — not libc — is under test, ruling out false-PASS). MEASURE-ONLY, byteeq-neutral. Now RUNS the value sweep and CAUGHT a real native endptr divergence (strtoll all-whitespace: native endptr=3 vs libc 0) — the flip gate works.

title: feat(runtime/selfemit): RFC061 §M8 SELFEMIT-FCNTL — x86_64-linux ELF hxlcl_fcntl native .o (HEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL, default-OFF)
body: feat(runtime): extend the darwin-arm64 SELFEMIT `fcntl` member to x86_64-linux via a self-contained ELF64 ET_REL emitter. NEW test/native_build/emit_hxlcl_fcntl_elf_o.hexa clones the strlen ELF fixture (emit_hxlcl_strlen_elf_o.hexa) — x86_64 arm emits the 8-byte class-C 3-arg NON-errno syscall leaf `mov eax,72; syscall; ret` (b8 48 00 00 00 / 0f 05 / c3; SYS_fcntl=72, C args rdi/rsi/rdx pass straight through to the kernel, no register shuffle), exports ONE strong global `hxlcl_fcntl` (bare, no `_`), NO reloc / NO errno provider / NO external callee (mirrors the darwin no-_cf leaf which likewise returns the raw trap result). arm64 = FAIL (arm64-linux fcntl is SYS 25 / svc #0, distinct from the darwin SYS 92 / svc #0x80 bytes — next rung). tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a: new SELFEMIT-FCNTL block after the SELFEMIT-STRLEN `fi` (:1645), gated `HEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL=1 && Linux && x86_64|amd64` (x86_64-only like RT-NATIVE-FMOD :1704); on success appends -DHEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL to _mo_shim_def + build/hxlcl_fcntl_native.o to _mo_hxlcl_members; the shim #ifndef guard already exists (self/runtime_core_hxlcl_shim_emit.hexa:1415). CO-DROP verified SAFE: fcntl is absent from the CO-DROP registry (:1562), the MEMLEAF list (:1668), and has NO RT-NATIVE-FCNTL block, so _mo_rtnative_syms can never contain 'fcntl' → exactly ONE provider, zero ld -r multidef risk (defensive case-skip added anyway for forward-safety, no-op today); no registry entry added (no seed to mirror per selfemit-smoke-4591-codrop-default-mismatch). DEFAULT-OFF (unset) → block + elif both skipped → _mo_shim_def / _mo_hxlcl_members unchanged → shim.o + runtime.a byte-identical (sha f2d507e1 / 151c52c8 invariant). Gate (pool aiden/summer): (1) byteeq 3-target default-OFF vs frozen; (2) member .text objdump == clang --target=x86_64-linux-gnu oracle b8 48 00 00 00 0f 05 c3; (3) LINK smoke flag-ON — ld -r multidef=0, hexa build exit42, fcntl(F_GETFL) parity vs libc. bash -n GREEN.

title: fix(emit): axis-① #4867 FLOOR-ALIAS `own` 예약어 지역변수 → own_name rename (build_aprime transpile 파싱에러 해소)
body: #4867(e9d5fa0f4)이 compiler/emit/elf_x86_64.hexa link_elf_x86_64_ownstart의 (A0) FLOOR-NAME ALIAS 패스에서 `let own = "hxlcl_" + bare`로 예약어 `own`(ownership/borrow lane)을 지역변수명으로 사용 → strict parser가 `unexpected token Own ('own')`로 거부, tool/build_aprime.sh stage [2/5] transpile 중단 → from-source 자기빌드(build_aprime→aprime_cc)가 깨짐. CI selfhost-gates는 prebuilt hexat 부트스트랩이라 신규 소스를 strict parser로 재파싱하지 않아 통과했고, fresh build_aprime flatten(pool)에서 노출됨. 실제 self-host 빌드 회귀. FIX=surgical rename only — 지역변수 `own`→`own_name` 2군데(선언 :1867 + `def_names[odi] == own_name` 비교 :1870). 주석/무관 코드의 `own`(own-link·@own·own-emit·own-start 등)은 미변경. A1 __errno_location 프로바이더 블록도 예약어-as-identifier 재점검 → 충돌 없음(errno_*/eci/eco/ecr/er/esym/enm/ek/eb/ez 모두 비예약어). pool build_aprime로 발견. 별개 이슈(own-link 결정성 + Route C errno-smoke)는 본 커밋 범위 밖, 별도 추적.

title: fix(link/ownstart): axis-① bug3 근인 종결 — archive_extract_fixpoint STB_LOCAL hxlcl_ floor-body pull + census data-driven alias → n_dyn→0 정적링크
body: axis-① bug3(`hexa build --target=linux-x86_64-glibc --linker=hexa` 가 PT_INTERP+n_dyn≈39 dyn-hybrid ELF 을 내 rc139 crash) 근인 확정: 진짜 게이트는 archive_extract_fixpoint. 그 member-pull 결정은 GLOBAL/WEAK def만 `wants`로 보는 armap 의미론인데, floor 바디 hxlcl_<X>는 STB_LOCAL(nm t)라 그것들을 담은 member가 절대 pull되지 않음 → bare floor UND <X>가 linked obj list에 부재 → census쪽 bare→hxlcl alias(A0 #4867 hardcoded-14, #4870 data-driven-all)가 아무것도 못 찾고(oidx<0) 빈집합 alias → n_dyn이 ≈39로 남아 PT_INTERP. 두 선행 fix가 동일하게 inert였던 이유 = 둘 다 hxlcl_<X>가 이미 pull되어 def_names에 있다고 가정했으나 member 자체가 pull된 적 없음. fix(2 loci, reference=`-static` armap 정답지 — armap은 멤버십만 결정, visibility는 body에 직접 bind): LOCUS-1 archive_extract_fixpoint에 own-link floor-pull 예외 추가 — GLOBAL/WEAK `wants`가 false일 때 und_names의 still-NEEDED bare <X>의 hxlcl_<X> body(any binding, section!=0)가 이 member에 있으면 wants=true로 pull, 그리고 GLOBAL-def fold 뒤에 미러 fold로 bare <X>를 def_names에 push(fixpoint 종료). LOCUS-2 census쪽 A0 alias를 hardcoded-14 블록 삭제 후 census 루프 내 data-driven으로 이동(runtime_defs>0 gate) — bare UND dnm이 undef이고 ldx에 hxlcl_<dnm>(LOCUS-1이 pull)이 있으면 그 seg/off에 GLOBAL bare alias를 synth하고 ldx에 index, ddef=true → dyn_names 미진입 → n_dyn→0 → STATIC serializer(no PT_INTERP) → raw-syscall exit, ld.so 없음. A1 __errno_location native provider는 그대로 유지. HEXA_LD_DUMP_DYN 진단 덤프 신규 추가(n_dyn+DYN-UND 리스트, env-gated, byte-neutral)로 pool 측정 가능. --linker=hexa opt-in 전용 — archive_extract_fixpoint/link_elf_x86_64_ownstart 는 link_elf_x86_64_ownstart_ar 경로에서만 도달, shipping C-transpile는 system ld 사용하므로 runtime.a symbol visibility 불변 → byteeq-neutral. 미검증: pool compile+run이 게이트(mini=git/gh only).
